# Evercraft Visual Intelligence Story Sprint

Problem: A business, newsroom, researcher or organization has real evidence, data or a complicated idea but lacks a visual story strong enough to stop attention and explain it clearly.

Founding price: $500 one-time for one accepted story.
Campaign: $1,500 for three accepted stories.

Start: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/offers/visual-intelligence
